275119430.description: This vintage pipe set features an Indonesian hand-carved wooden pipe holder designed as a tree trunk with a detailed bearded face on the front. The stand includes seven circular slots on top to hold tobacco pipes. Accompanying the stand are assorted vintage smoking pipes made from various materials including wood, meerschaum, and metal. The pipes vary in style, with one featuring a carved face and another with a bent stem. Both the stand and pipes show wear and patina consistent with age and use remain in used collectible condition. This set is suitable for collectors of tobacciana or rustic vintage decor.

274891364.description:
Large natural pink amethyst geode mineral specimen with a partially polished face. Measures approximately 9 inches wide by 7.75 inches tall by 3 inches deep. Features light tan, white, and subtle orange hues with well-defined quartz or calcite crystals inside. Some edge flaking present. The specimen does have a wobble, may need to shim for stability. Weighs approximately 9 pounds 4.5 ounces. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
This piece has a unique formation. In the center there is a central pillar with a spiral formation around it giving this piece all it's chambers. Many of the formed crystals are very square, others almost dogtooth in shape. The chamber plates are thin at 3mm.
